_comment: Configure real procurement RSS/Atom feed URLs below — this connector fetches nothing until at least one is added, same pattern as demand-intelligence/runtime/config/demand-signal-categories.json's feedUrls. Each entry's own 'sourceType' is never guessed from content — it's exactly what you label it here (Government, Banking, Healthcare, UN, World Bank, ADB, EU, UAE, or Public AI Governance).

recommendedResponseByFitBand.High: Prepare a full response — strong fit, worth the effort.
recommendedResponseByFitBand.Medium: Register interest and monitor — review the full tender documents before committing effort.
recommendedResponseByFitBand.Low: Note only — low fit against current service lines; skip unless something changes.
